headline: South Korea Consumer Sentiment Declines to 103.1 in November
summary: South Korea's Composite Consumer Sentiment Index slipped 2.3 points month-over-month to 103.1 in November 2026, according to survey data from the Bank of Korea.
why: The Bank of Korea tracks monthly consumer sentiment to gauge household economic confidence in South Korea, an export-dependent Asian economy.

impacts.name: South Korea
impacts.why: Consumer sentiment in South Korea fell by 2.3 points in November.
